title: Scheduler alert-rule gauge metrics: three places must change together
answers: How do I add a new per-org/per-label alert rule count metric?
Where is grafana_alerting_plugin_origin_rules / rule_group_rules / prometheus_imported_rules computed?
Why is my new scheduler gauge metric not resetting / showing stale label combinations?
body:
Symptom: a new per-org breakdown gauge (like rule_group_rules, prometheus_imported_rules, simplified_editor_rules, plugin_origin_rules) is missing, or shows stale label combinations from previous ticks.
Root cause: these GaugeVecs are declared in pkg/services/ngalert/metrics/scheduler.go:NewSchedulerMetrics, cleared each tick in pkg/services/ngalert/metrics/scheduler.go:Scheduler.ResetRuleMetrics, and recomputed from the full rule list in pkg/services/ngalert/schedule/metrics.go:updateRulesMetrics. All three must be kept in sync.
Fix pattern: declare the GaugeVec with its label set, add a `.Reset()` call for it in ResetRuleMetrics, and in updateRulesMetrics build a `map[orgID]map[label]int64` while iterating alertRules once, then call `WithLabelValues(orgID, label).Set(count)` per entry after the loop.
Constraints: applies to any new per-org/per-category alert rule count gauge computed on every scheduler tick; does not apply to counters or histograms that accumulate across ticks (those should not be Reset).
applies: adding or modifying per-org alert rule count gauges in the ngalert scheduler
says: Per-organization alert rule count metric missing or shows stale data
How do I add a new per-organization breakdown for alert metrics?
Alert rule gauge metric not resetting between scheduler ticks
New rule count breakdown shows previous tick's label combinations
Where are the per-org alert rule count metrics computed and cleared?
search: Per-org alert rule count gauges (rule_group_rules, prometheus_imported_rules, simplified_editor_rules, plugin_origin_rules) require synchronized updates in three locations: GaugeVec declaration in pkg/services/ngalert/metrics/scheduler.go:NewSchedulerMetrics, Reset() call in ResetRuleMetrics, and recomputation in pkg/services/ngalert/schedule/metrics.go:updateRulesMetrics. Build a map[orgID]map[label]int64 during single alertRules iteration, then call WithLabelValues(orgID, label).Set(count) per entry. Applies only to per-org/per-category counts computed each tick; not to accumulators. Stale label combinations from prior ticks indicate desync.
